identity_gate.proposal: Four banks ordered -72,-100,+72,+100; fore-to-aft25 rows per bank. This matches every labelled join but is not original registry evidence. Adopt only after explicit root reconciliation. Physical chunks use immutable footprint keys.

runtime_contract.shells: Separate per-room bounded native mesh batches with actual aperture metadata
runtime_contract.fitout: Separate per-room static furnishing batches. Persistent/interactive stock must be separate owned nodes later. No entire-promenade merged mesh.
runtime_contract.courts: 18 public chunks, each at most three rows/78 m plus16m width; service similarly bounded
runtime_contract.activation: Root may load a current room plus direct neighbours and current court; keep floor and contact resident before rendering/unloading. Hysteresis/streaming implementation is later root work.
runtime_contract.visibility: Glass excluded from opaque occluders; no occluders across portals, streets, protected voids or full AABBs.
